faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Technical Support / Officer III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JIPMER Project Technical Support / Officer III post is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year Graduation degree in Engineering/IT/CS/EC or a BCA/MCA-related field, or a master's degree in engineering/IT/CS/EC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support / Officer III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support / Officer III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month, plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is JIP/MEDONCO/ICMR/2026/1.8.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER).

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job.
